name: Fried shrimp cake
summary: Fried shrimp cake is one of the plates Can Tho is known for. It is a different snack from bánh cống, the mung-bean and taro fritter.
howToEat: Look for it with the city’s other plates; bánh cống is a separate fritter.
seoTitle: Fried shrimp cake in Can Tho
seoDescription: Fried shrimp cake, one of Can Tho’s plates, and not the same snack as bánh cống.
